sample_mapping_evidence: Original GEO biological specimen records and source donor IDs; all repeated patient IDs stay linked.

source_metadata.access: Public GEO processed count matrices; controlled raw sequence access not required

title: Patient 1, timepoint 1, scRNA-seq
extract_protocol_ch1: Frozen cells were resuspended using 1xPBS solution and then filtered through a 40 µm filter. A small portion of the cell solution was mixed with AOPI and placed on a cell counting slide to check the viability (LUNA-FL™ Automated Fluorescence Cell Counter). Cells with viability over 70% were used for sequencing.

scRNA-seq: Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5’ Kit v2 and Chromium Next GEM Chip K Single Cell Kit were used to generate barcoded 5’ single cell library (10X Genomics Chromium Instrument). Each cDNA library that passed the quality control (Agilent Bioanalyzer) was sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq6000 and NextSeq500.

scV(D)J-seq: TCR and BCR sequencing was performed using cDNA synthesized by the nested-PCR enrichment method. TCR and BCR libraries were generated using the Chromium Single Cell Human TCR and BCR Amplification Kit (10X Genomics), and each library was checked for quality control (Agilent Bioanalyzer) before sequencing.
data_processing: 10x Genomics Cell Ranger (version 6.0.0) was used for sequencing reads mapping against the GRCh38 human reference genome, UMI counting and cell filtering. A reference genome was applied from 10X Genomics.
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values and matrix files (scRNA gene expression)
Supplementary files format and content: Commna--separated values and matrix files (TCR, BCR clonotypes)
